title: In a first, US will allow some private firms to carry out cyberattacks | TechCrunch
summary: The U.S. government will for the first time allow vetted private companies to launch offensive cyber operations against international criminal gangs and hackers, the White House said on Wednesday. The memorandum stops short of allowing companies to “hack back” any cyber threats.
